scenes.text: Taskmaverick automatically guides teams to take initiatives on their own
There is no need for a human manager to constantly remind people
Work Missions can be automatically assigned to people on their Personal Boards…
….or they can be posted on Team Boards to facilitate cooperation
Multiple people can share a single device to save on hardware costs
Each person enters their personal code to Claim a Mission
After performing the work, they enter their code again to Close the Mission
When clearly displayed, a shared device can effectively engage a whole team
No important task is ever forgotten or delayed
Taskmaverick increases efficiency by keeping everyone engaged and informed
Everyone can see what Missions were completed…
…what Missions are being performed…
…and what Missions remain due…
No time is wasted on duplicating work that was performed by someone else…
…and no time is wasted wondering what to do next
Mission timers increase efficiency by creating a sense of urgency
They change in color as they age…from Green…to Orange…to Red
A critical Mission can escalate quicker than a regular Mission…
This allows important work to become automatically prioritized, without human input
Clever Gamification can also be used to boost efficiency
Taskmaverick allows reward points to be added to Missions
Undesirable Missions can offer higher points to increase motivation
Performance improves when individual contributions can be recognized and rewarded
That is why each performer’s name is clearly stamped on their Missions
Their execution duration is also tracked per Mission
A clear record is maintained per mission, per person and per team
Taskmaverick increases efficiency by engaging, motivating, and rewarding teams
Excessive delays can trigger Alerts to management
Excessive aging can flag managers with Alert Tickets
